name: FleetPilot
description: Self-hosted operations dashboard for home labs and small companies: server updates, SMART disk health, routers (FRITZ!Box, OpenWrt, OPNsense, pfSense, MikroTik), Proxmox VMs, TrueNAS/Unraid storage, backup servers and fans, managed over SSH and APIs without agents.

notes.text: Open https://<container-ip> and accept the self-signed certificate once. Sign in as admin; the password is DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in /opt/fleetpilot/.env. Change it after the first sign-in under My Profile and set up two-factor sign-in.

FleetPilot manages other machines over SSH with the key /root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub inside the container. Add that key to each server's authorized_keys, or use Manage Hosts → Install Key. To manage the Proxmox node itself, add the node as a host the same way.
Update FleetPilot with this script's update function. The in-app 'FleetPilot update' page expects a git checkout and does not apply to this container.
